me.intro: I build elegant interfaces with clean structure, thoughtful motion and a strong focus on modern user experience. My focus is front-end and UI with React.

who.title: Who I am
who.text: I'm Mohammad Baharlou, a developer who enjoys creating sleek digital experiences that feel refined, intuitive and modern.

journey.title: My journey
journey.text: For the last 5 years I've been sharpening my programming skills, with a strong interest in front-end technologies, design systems and interaction details.

education.title: Education
education.text: I study Public Relations and Advertising at Anadolu University in Eskişehir, which gives me a different perspective on communication and presentation.

work.title: Work
work.text: I work in the Design & Development team at Coalition Technologies.

home.title: Where I live
home.text: I live in Eskişehir, Turkey, where I keep studying and growing as a developer and creative thinker.

languages.title: Languages
languages.text: I speak English, Turkish and Persian, which helps me connect with different audiences and communities.
